prompt: Why does the woman ask for two bottles?
promptZh: 女子為什麼要用兩個瓶子？
explanationZh: 男子本想整壺加糖，但黛娜喜歡不另外加糖，所以要先分裝。

options.text: To make the bottles easier to cool in ice water.
options.zh: 讓瓶子更容易用冰水降溫。
options.whyZh: 冰水說明紙標籤不耐用，不是分裝理由。

options.text: To test which cap is easiest to open.
options.zh: 測試哪種瓶蓋比較好開。
options.whyZh: 瓶蓋紋路只用於辨認，沒有測試開瓶難易。

options.text: To set aside some drink before it is sweetened.
options.zh: 在加糖前先留出一部分飲料。
options.whyZh: 男子本想整壺加糖，但黛娜喜歡不另外加糖，所以要先分裝。

options.text: To carry a different kind of drink in each bottle.
options.zh: 在每瓶裝不同種類的飲料。
options.whyZh: 分的是同一壺水果飲料，不是兩種飲料。

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The fruit drink is almost ready. I was going to sweeten the whole pitcher before we leave.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Could you pour some into a second bottle before adding the sugar? Dana likes it plain. Give her the bottle with the smooth lid. The lid on the other bottle has ridges.
